name: Tropica Specialised Nutrition
description: Macro+micro all-in-one for actively-growing high-light tanks (contains N + P). Tropica does not publish a full per-dose ppm breakdown, so values are NOT disclosed — qualitative `affects` only.
notes: Label dose ~6 ml per 200 L weekly. Use the 'Premium' (N/P-free) variant instead when nitrate/phosphate are supplied by stocking.
